articles.summary: Protagonist Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company with a proprietary technology platform focused on discovering and developing peptide-based new chemical entities (NCEs) that can potentially transform existing treatment paradigms in disease areas with significant unmet medical needs.
articles.title: Discovery and Characterization of Novel Oral Peptide Antagonists of Human IL-23 Receptor that are Efficacious in a Rat Model of IBD
